title: Live: College Football
description: The Purdue Boilermakers host the Wisconsin Badgers at Ross-Ade Stadium in West Lafayette for a college football game. Purdue looks to break a four-game skid behind Ryan Browne, while Wisconsin has alternate wins and losses in their last six games.

title: Live: College Football
description: The SMU Mustangs visit the No. 6 Notre Dame Fighting Irish for an NCAA Division I FBS game. SMU lost 49-7 to Wake Forest on Nov. 14 with Kevin Jennings, while the Notre Dame Fighting Irish ride a three-game win streak with CJ Carr in Week 12.
